# Heronite

> Heronite is a free, open source (GPL-3.0) game launcher for Linux and Windows, written in Rust. It brings Steam, Epic Games, GOG, Amazon Games, Battle.net, EA app, Ubisoft Connect, Rockstar Games, emulated and DRM-free games into one library, records every play session, and has a controller-first console mode.

## Start
- [Download](https://heronite.app/download/): Windows installer and portable zip, Linux AppImage, .deb, .rpm and Arch packages
- [Features](https://heronite.app/features/): every part of the app
- [Documentation](https://heronite.app/docs/): installation, setup, reference and troubleshooting
- [FAQ](https://heronite.app/docs/faq/)

## Guides
- [Guides](https://heronite.app/guides/): Epic Games, GOG, Amazon, Battle.net, EA app, Ubisoft Connect and Rockstar on Linux; Steam Deck; installing GE-Proton
